поругаться.gloss: to quarrel, to have a fight

meanings.en: to quarrel, to have an argument
meanings.note: Prefix 'по-' forms perfective verbs or marks a brief/onset action (stem 'ругаться'). Used in Russian as a perfective verb focusing on a single completed action or result meaning 'to quarrel', forming an aspectual pair with 'ругаться'. The reflexive suffix '-ся'/'-сь' makes the action intransitive, reciprocal, or directed at the subject.

examples.trans: We will have a pretend quarrel in front of her.

examples.text: Нам нужно срочно поругаться перед ней.
examples.trans: We need to quarrel in front of her right away.

examples.text: Мы поругаемся понарошку, только для вида.
examples.trans: We will quarrel in pretend, only for show.

meanings.note: Prefix 'рас-' ('apart, un-, thoroughly') indicates distribution or intensive action (stem 'строиться'). Reflexive/intransitive verb with the postfix '-ся'/'-сь' (historically from the reflexive pronoun 'себя', oneself). Used as a perfective (single completed action) verb meaning 'to get upset', paired with 'расстраиваться'.

examples.text: Он очень сильно удивился и расстроился.
examples.trans: He was very surprised and upset.
